material: PLA (Yousu white, 1.75 mm), HERMES printer, nozzle 0.4 mm 215 C, bed 55 C, layer 0.2 mm, 100% infill, 3200 mm/min. Fatigue specimens YZ (on-edge): concentric-infill plates 67 x 195 mm, laser-cut along the filament direction, so filaments run along the load axis; notches and holes LASER-CUT (no perimeter bead around them).

sources.all: Seifollahi & Kabir 2026, Polymers 18(1):1, doi 10.3390/polym18010001 (PMC12787623): Tables 1, 3, 5, 6, 7; Fig. 1

test: axial sinusoidal 5 Hz, R = 0.05 (sigma_min/sigma_max), to fracture (ASTM D7791-12); stresses on the net section. Two 'representative' lives per level reported, others excluded by the authors, so the scatter is understated.
N_ref_note: inside the tested life range of all three groups (hole 9.1e3-2.2e4); strengths are Basquin fits of Table 6 (equal to the paper's Table 7 to 0.05 %) evaluated at N_ref; T = sigma_10%/sigma_90% from the fit residual

plain_specimen.note: ASTM D638 type I: W 13, T 3.2, narrow length 57, gauge 50, fillet R 76

specimen_note: double semicircular edge notches R 2 (net 9 mm) and a central hole R 2 (net 9 mm) in the 13 x 3.2 narrow section; L = 60 models the 57 mm narrow length (grip traction far from the root)
